text: {"sql": "SELECT m.machine_id, CAST(t.ts AS DATE) AS day, SUM(CASE WHEN t.failure = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failure_count, SUM(CASE WHEN t.heat_dissipation_failure = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS heat_dissipation_failure_count, SUM(CASE WHEN t.overstrain_failure = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overstrain_failure_count, ROUND(AVG(t.air_temp_k), 1) AS avg_air_temp_k, ROUND(AVG(t.tool_wear_min), 1) AS avg_tool_wear_min FROM sf_plant.stations s JOIN sf_plant.machines m ON m.station_id = s.station_id JOIN sf_plant.machine_telemetry t ON t.machine_id = m.machine_id WHERE s.station_id = 'F10' GROUP BY m.machine_id, CAST(t.ts AS DATE) ORDER BY failure_count DESC", "columns": ["machine_id", "day", "failure_count", "heat_dissipation_failure_count", "overstrain_failure_count", "avg_air_temp_k", "avg_tool_wear_min"], "purpose": "Summarize F10 station machine telemetry failures and daily averages by machine and date"}

data.sql: SELECT m.machine_id, CAST(t.ts AS DATE) AS day, SUM(CASE WHEN t.failure = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failure_count, SUM(CASE WHEN t.heat_dissipation_failure = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS heat_dissipation_failure_count, SUM(CASE WHEN t.overstrain_failure = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overstrain_failure_count, ROUND(AVG(t.air_temp_k), 1) AS avg_air_temp_k, ROUND(AVG(t.tool_wear_min), 1) AS avg_tool_wear_min FROM sf_plant.stations s JOIN sf_plant.machines m ON m.station_id = s.station_id JOIN sf_plant.machine_telemetry t ON t.machine_id = m.machine_id WHERE s.station_id = 'F10' GROUP BY m.machine_id, CAST(t.ts AS DATE) ORDER BY failure_count DESC
data.purpose: Summarize F10 station machine telemetry failures and daily averages by machine and date
